user.title: Connect to Firefly III
user.description: Enter the address of your Firefly III server and a Personal Access Token. Create the token in Firefly III under **Options → Profile → OAuth → Personal Access Tokens → Create new token**.

data_description.access_token: The long token Firefly III shows once after creating it.

select.title: Choose what to show in Home Assistant
select.description: Found: {accounts} accounts, {piggy_banks} piggy banks and {bills} subscriptions. Tick what you want to add. You can always change this later via **Configure** on the integration.

data_description.piggy_banks: Per piggy bank: current amount, target, left to save, percentage and target date.
data_description.bills: Per subscription: (average) amount and next expected payment date.

reauth_confirm.title: New token required
reauth_confirm.description: Firefly III at {url} no longer accepts the stored token. Create a new Personal Access Token and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Change the URL, token or SSL setting.

data_description.access_token: Leave empty to keep the current token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Firefly III. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or expired.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Firefly III server is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The new token has been saved.
